{{Quote|Those... Creatures have gone. The Imperial troops have gone. And... And I'm ''alive'' again. But I ''died''. I ''felt'' myself die. So how... How could... Forget it. I'm alive again. The '''mission to Bedlam''' was undertaken by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Mission-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|My leg's almost ''healed'' since it was injured on that last mission...|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Star Wars 35" />}}
[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] injures her ankle in ''[[Tilotny Throws a Shape]]''. She appears with a bandaged ankle in [[Star Wars (1977) 35|''Star Wars'' (1977) 35]].
